Comparison

ChatGPT vs Gemini

A side-by-side look at ChatGPT and Gemini, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose ChatGPT when your priority is: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Choose Gemini when your priority is: anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.

Pricing notes

ChatGPT

Free $0 (ad-supported since the 2026 ad rollout). Go $8/mo. Plus $20/mo. Pro sold as two usage tiers: $100/mo (5x Plus usage) and $200/mo (20x Plus usage, priority compute, ~250 Deep Research tasks). Business $20/seat/mo annual or $25/seat/mo monthly (2-seat minimum; cut from $25/$30 in April 2026); a Premium seat runs roughly $100-125. Enterprise custom, annual contract. API billed per token, separate bill.

Gemini

Free $0. Google AI Plus $4.99/mo (cut from $7.99 on 8 June 2026; 400 GB storage, 2x free limits). Google AI Pro $19.99/mo (4x limits, 5 TB storage, YouTube Premium Lite, Google Home Premium, 1,000 Flow credits). Google AI Ultra in two tiers since I/O 2026: $99.99/mo (5x Pro, 20 TB) and $199.99/mo (20x Pro, reduced from $249.99; adds Project Genie). Annual billing now available on every paid plan. Gemini is bundled into Workspace Business Standard/Plus/Enterprise - the standalone Workspace add-on was dropped in 2025.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: ChatGPT ↗ · Gemini ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between ChatGPT and Gemini?

ChatGPT: General-purpose conversational assistant built on OpenAI's GPT model family. Gemini: Google's multimodal assistant, sold through the Google AI consumer subscription ladder (formerly 'Gemini Advanced') and bundled into Google Workspace.

When should I choose ChatGPT over Gemini?

ChatGPT is listed as best for: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Gemini is listed as best for: anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.

Do ChatGPT and Gemini have a free plan?

ChatGPT: Yes. Gemini: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
